result.topic_en: Calculations with integrals p, q, u over s with denominator Δ, deriving partial differential relations in x and log c, and transforming the integrands, apparently for the rotating fluid ellipsoid problem.
result.transcription:
$p=\int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(\frac{s+1}{s^2+2xs+1}-\frac{c^3}{c^3+s}\right)$ $q=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(\frac{s-1}{s^2+2xs+1}+\frac{c^3}{c^3+s}\right)$ $u=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}$
$p+q=-2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$ $(x+1)p+(x-1)q=2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u=x(p+q)+p-q$
$p-q=2x\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u$
$p=(x-1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-u$ $\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}=(x-1)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial\log c}$
$q=-(1+x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}+u$ $\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}=-(1+x)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}$
$2p-\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log c}=(1-x)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}-\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial\log c^2}+2(x-1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u$
$2q-\frac{\partial q}{\partial\log c}=(1+x)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}+\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial\log c^2}-2(x+1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-3\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}+2u$
$2p+(x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}=(xx-1)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}+(x+1)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}+2(x-1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u$
$=\frac13\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}(2x+3+\frac1{c^3})-(1+\frac{1}{2c^3})\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac53\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u$
$2(c^3+\frac1{c^3}-2x)(2p+(x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x})=2(c^3+\frac1{c^3}-2x)\left(-(1+\frac1{2c^3})\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac53\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u\right)$
$+(2x+3+\frac1{c^3})\left((\frac1{c^3}-x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-[-2u-]\right)$
$\left(-(c^3-x)(2+\frac1{c^3})+(\frac1{c^3}-x)(2x+1)\right)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}\left(\frac{10}{3}c^3-\frac{14}{3}x+3+\frac{13}{3c^3}\right)-u(4c^3-6x+3+\frac{5}{c^3})$
$\frac{1}{c^3}(3x+1)-2xx+x-1-2c^3$

$\frac{3}{3}(c^3+\frac1{c^3}-2x)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}-[-2-](\frac1{c^3}-x)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u=(2x+1-\frac1{c^3})p+(2x-1-\frac1{c^3})q$
$=(x+1)p+(x-1)q$
$x-\frac1{c^3}\quad+x-\frac1{c^3}$
$-6c^3+(2xc^3+1)u=(x+1)p(1-3c^3+2xc^3)+(x-1)q(1+3c^3+2xc^3)$
$=(1+2xc^3)(2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-2u)-3c^3((x+1)p-(x-1)q)$
$(1+2xc^3)(\frac23\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}-u)=c^3((x+1)p-(x-1)q+2)$

$(\frac1{c^3}+2x)(2p+(x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x})=\frac23\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}(\frac1{c^3}+3+2x)(\frac{1}{2c^3}+x)+\left(p(x+2+\frac1{2c^3})+q(x+\frac1{2c^3})\right)(x+\frac1{2c^3})+(x+1)p-(x-1)q+2$

$(x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}-(x-1)\frac{\partial q}{\partial x}=2(xx-1)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}+2x\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}$
$=+\frac23(2x+\frac1{c^3})\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x\partial\log c}-[-\dots-](x+\frac1{2c^3})\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}$

$1+(\frac1{c^3}+1)s+\frac1{c^3}s^2$
$-1\quad+2xs\quad-1$
$\frac1{c^3}<2x-1$ $\int\frac{s^2-s}{\Delta^3}\partial s$
$\frac1{c^3}<1$
$p=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{-s^2+(2x+1)s}{s^2+2xs+1}+\frac{s}{c^3+s}\partial s$
$\int-2s(1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12}d(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12}=+\int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{2(1+2xs+s^2)-2s(x+s)}{(1+2xs+s^2)}$
$=+\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{2(1+xs)}{(1+2xs+s^2)}=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s}{c^3+s}$
$(xx-1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(\frac1{c^3}-x)-\frac{1}{2c^3}u+1$
$(x+1)p=\frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}(\frac1{c^3}+2x+3)-(\frac1{2c^3}+1)u+1$
$p=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(2+s-s^2)s}{(1+2xs+s^2)}$
$\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta(s+c^3)}\;\frac12 s(\frac1{c^3}+2x+3)-(s+c^3)(\frac{1}{2c^3}+1)$
$p=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(2-s)(1+s)}{1+2xs+s^2}$ $q=\int_0^\infty\frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{(2+s)s-1}{(1+2xs+s^2)}$
$s(2x+\frac12)-(\frac12+c^3)$

$\frac{1}{4c^6}\quad\frac1{c^6}+\frac2{c^3}\quad\frac1{c^6}+\frac8{c^3}+4\quad\frac8{c^3}+16\quad16$
$\frac{3}{2c^9}\quad\frac3{c^9}+\frac6{c^6}\quad\frac3{c^9}+\frac{24}{c^6}+\frac{12}{c^3}\quad\frac{24}{c^6}+\frac{48}{c^3}\quad\frac{48}{c^3}$

$\frac{(\frac1s-s)(\dots+3(2-\frac1{c^3}))}{(2+\frac1s)\sqrt{1+\frac{s}{c^3}}+(2+s)\sqrt{1+\frac{1}{c^3s}}}$ $c^3=\frac12$
$\frac{4}{c^3s}+4+\frac1{c^3}$
$-\frac{(1+\frac s2)^2}{(1+2s)^{\frac32}}+\frac{(1+\frac{1}{2s})^2}{(1+\frac2s)^{\frac32}}$
$\frac{4}{c^3}(\frac1s-s)+(4+\frac1{c^3})(s-\frac1s)+s^2-\frac1{s^2}$

methods.what: Definition of integrals p, q, u
Expressing p+q via derivative of u in x
Expressing p and q via derivatives of u
Linear relation between u-derivatives and p,q
First-order PDE for u in x and log c
Integration by parts to transform integral
Simplified integrand forms for p and q
